standard.summary: 多种 LoRA 变体汇总：Delta-LoRA（更新差分优化）/ HydraLoRA（多头 LoRA，平衡不同特征）/ TensorRing（张量环 LoRA）/ FlexRank（弹性秩）/ LoftQ（量化初始化）/ LoKr（Kronecker 分解）。
standard.effect: 各变体在标准 LoRA 基础上提供不同的参数效率或正则化特性：Delta-LoRA 优化 LoRA 的更新增量；HydraLoRA 多分支学习不同特征方向；LoftQ 为量化基座模型提供优化初始化；LoKr 使用 Kronecker 分解。
standard.whenToUse: 各变体均为实验性功能，需要根据具体任务对比测试。大多数场景标准 LoRA 已经足够，只有明确的参数效率或质量需求时才尝试变体。
standard.avoidWhen: 这些变体通常不与推理框架（A1111/ComfyUI）的标准 LoRA 加载器兼容，使用前确认推理端支持该变体格式。

standard_en.summary: A round-up of LoRA variants: Delta-LoRA (optimises the update difference) / HydraLoRA (multi-head LoRA balancing different features) / TensorRing (tensor-ring LoRA) / FlexRank (elastic rank) / LoftQ (quantisation-aware initialisation) / LoKr (Kronecker factorisation).
standard_en.effect: Each variant adds a different parameter-efficiency or regularisation property on top of standard LoRA: Delta-LoRA optimises the LoRA's update increment; HydraLoRA learns different feature directions on several branches; LoftQ gives a quantised base model a better initialisation; LoKr uses a Kronecker factorisation.
standard_en.whenToUse: All of these are experimental and need a comparative test on your own task. Standard LoRA is enough for most cases; reach for a variant only with a definite parameter-efficiency or quality need.
standard_en.avoidWhen: These variants are usually incompatible with the standard LoRA loaders in inference frameworks (A1111, ComfyUI), so confirm your inference side supports the format before using one.

advanced.principle: Delta-LoRA：只更新 LoRA 增量方向（∆W），固定 A/B 矩阵的乘积方向；HydraLoRA：多个 A 矩阵共享一个 B 矩阵（或反之），每个 A 学习不同特征子空间；LoftQ：先量化基座，再用 SVD 初始化 LoRA 补偿量化误差；lokr_factor 控制 LoKr 的 Kronecker 分解维度比例（通常为 ⌈√d_in⌉ × ⌈√d_out⌉）。fractional_grad_damping/grad_cosine 是梯度控制技术，通过阻尼或余弦相似性约束梯度更新方向。
advanced.tradeoffs: 变体越复杂（如 TensorRing），与现有推理基础设施的兼容性越低，导出和部署成本越高。建议在实验阶段使用，产品化前确认端到端可用。

advanced_en.principle: Delta-LoRA: only updates the LoRA increment direction (∆W), fixing the product direction of the A/B matrices. HydraLoRA: multiple A matrices share one B matrix (or vice versa), each A learning a different feature subspace. LoftQ: quantizes the base first, then initializes the LoRA with SVD to compensate quantization error. lokr_factor controls LoKr's Kronecker factorization dimension ratio (usually ⌈√d_in⌉ × ⌈√d_out⌉). fractional_grad_damping/grad_cosine are gradient-control techniques constraining update direction via damping or cosine similarity.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The more complex the variant (e.g. TensorRing), the lower its compatibility with existing inference infrastructure and the higher the export/deployment cost. Use in experiments and confirm end-to-end usability before productizing.
